body: City Council Study Session and Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL STUDY SESSION AND REGULAR MEETING
  JUNE 16, 2020
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE
PROVISIONS OF THE GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDER N-25-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC AND VIDEOCONFERENCED. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING,
EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (872) 240-3212; ACCESS
CODE: 155-352-973 TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM OR UNDER ORAL COMMUNICATIONS. THE MEETING MAY
BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  5:30 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
 Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
 the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
 subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
 minutes.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
 certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
 matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
 has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
 telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meeting of June 2,
  2020. 825-04

  Minutes

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period May 3, 2020 – May 16,
  2020, in the total amount of $826,187.01. 630

  Report
 3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period May
  28, 2020 through June 10, 2020, in the total amount of $925,126.56. 640

  Warrant Register

4.  CLAIMS AGAINST THE CITY – Staff recommends City Council deny the claim filed by Peggy McDuffie
  and Adriana Ramirez. 830-18

  Report

5.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – JUNE 10, 2020 - No action is required unless the City
  Council elects to review the decision of the Planning Commission on those items where the
  Commission’s action was final. 320

  Report

6.  PROJECT NOS. 7852/7853 - ACCEPT WORK FOR REPLACEMENT OF FLOORING AND
  BLEACHERS AT THE NORWALK ARTS AND SPORTS COMPLEX - Staff recommends City Council
  accept the work of McWil Sports Surfaces, Inc. in the amount of $312,883 for hardwood flooring and
  bleacher replacements at the Norwalk Arts and Sports Complex. 1005-04-7852/7853

  Report

7.  AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 7 – PARKING MANAGEMENT SERVICES – EXTENDING TERM
  TO JUNE 30, 2021 - Staff recommends City Council approve Amendment No. 7 with Parking Concepts
  Incorporated, extending the term of the agreement for an additional one-year term beginning July 1,
  2020 with no cost adjustment; and authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of
  the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 920-04/810-16

  Report

8.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-41 – STATEMENT OF INVESTMENT POLICY - Staff recommends City Council
  adopt Resolution No. 20-41, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK,
  ADOPTING THE 2020/21 STATEMENT OF INVESTMENT POLICY, AND AUTHORIZING THE CITY
  TREASURER TO INVEST AND REINVEST IDLE MONIES OF THE CITY OF NORWALK IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE 2020/21 STATEMENT OF INVESTMENT POLICY. 624

  Report

9.  PROJECT NO. 7448 – APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS AND AUTHORIZATION TO
  ADVERTISE FOR BIDS ON WELL NO. 10 EMERGENCY GENERATOR INSTALLATION PROJECT -
  Staff recommends City Council approve the plans and specifications for the Well No. 10 Emergency
  Generator Installation Project, authorize the advertisement of bids, and schedule a bid opening date of
  July 22, 2020. 1005-04-7448

  Report

10. PROJECT NO. 7798-R – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK – REHABILITATION OF GERDES PARK
  PARKING LOT, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-11 - Staff recommends City Council accept the work of
  Pavewest Inc., of Artesia for $80,160.34 for the rehabilitation of Gerdes Park Parking Lot, Project No.
  7798-R. 1005-04-7798

  Report

11. AUTHORIZATION TO SUBMIT FEDERAL TRANSIT ADMINISTRATION PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION
  AGENCY SAFETY PLAN (PTASP) FOR FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 - Staff recommends City Council
  receive and file the Public Transportation Agency Safety Plan and authorize the Executive Director of
  Regional Transportation to submit the PTASP to FTA for Fiscal Year 2020/21. 1120

  Report

12. AMENDMENT NO. 1 - FEDERAL ADVOCACY SERVICES - Staff recommends City Council approve
  Amendment No. 1 with Carpi & Clay from July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2022 at a cost of $24,000
  annually; and authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City in a form
   approved by the City Attorney. 120-01

  Report

  13. RESOLUTION NO. 20-42 - ADOPTION OF ANNUAL APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR THE FISCAL
  YEAR 2020/21 - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution 20-42, A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK APPROVING AND ADOPTING THE ANNUAL
  APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2020/21. 604

  Report

  14. 2020 APPLICATIONS FOR RETAIL FIREWORKS SALES PERMITS – Staff recommends City Council
  approve the organizations eligible to obtain retail firework permits and authorize issuance of permits.
  612-08

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  Body members or make new appointments for two-year terms beginning April 1, 2020 through

  Report

RESOLUTIONS

  DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT ECONOMIC RECOVERY STIMULUS PROGRAM – Staff

  THE CITY OF NORWALK APPROVING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE COMMUNITY

  17. RESOLUTION NO. 20-45 – AUTHORIZING DEFERRAL OF CERTAIN DEVELOPMENT IMPACT

  18. RESOLUTION NO. 20-46 - AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO IMPLEMENT A TEMPORARY
  OUTDOOR DINING PROGRAM TO ALLOW THE EXPANSION OF OUTDOOR RESTAURANT
  SEATING - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-46, A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO IMPLEMENT
  A TEMPORARY OUTDOOR DINING PROGRAM TO ALLOW THE EXPANSION OF OUTDOOR

  Report

PUBLIC HEARINGS
